description: This file is a shell script for performance testing the core.fsmonitor feature in Git, including setup, configuration, and execution of various performance tests with different fsmonitor configurations.

methods.name: trace_start
methods.description: Initializes trace logging if GIT_PERF_7519_TRACE is set, creating a directory and setting environment variables for trace output.

methods.name: trace_stop
methods.description: Unsets trace environment variables to stop trace logging.

methods.name: touch_files
methods.description: Creates a specified number of files in a directory.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing a series of commands.

methods.name: setup_for_fsmonitor_hook
methods.description: Configures the core.fsmonitor hook, choosing between Watchman and an empty script based on environment and prerequisites.

methods.name: test_perf_w_drop_caches
methods.description: Runs performance tests with optional cache dropping based on environment variable.

methods.name: test_fsmonitor_suite
methods.description: Runs a suite of performance tests with different configurations of the fsmonitor feature.
